subject: Coord: Hosted integration technical deep-dive — SDK / streaming / tool calls
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@healthspringlabs.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kyle Rivera <kyle.rivera@healthspringlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + request for technical deep-dive on Hosted API integration

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick follow-up during the product intro last week. HealthSpring's platform team is interested in a focused technical session to validate how Redwood's Hosted API will fit into our ingestion/serving pipeline. Key items we'd like covered:

- SDK support (Python + Node) and recommended client patterns for long-running sessions
- Streaming responses and chunked payload handling (we have low-latency constraints)
- Tool/function-calling patterns and best practices for orchestrating external lookups
- Authentication/rotation, and telemetry hooks for tracing requests

We're aiming for a 45–60 minute session with both product and engineering present. Our preferred windows next week (PST):
- Tues Oct 6: 9:30–11:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Oct 7: 10:00–12:00

If you can loop in the Redwood SE who'd drive the demo/architecture details that'd be great.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Director of Platform Engineering
HealthSpring Labs
---

Hi Emily — thanks for outlining the topics. Monica (cc'd) is our Solutions Engineer who will lead the technical walkthrough.

We're available for a 60-minute session and can cover SDK patterns, streaming, and tool calling with a short live sample. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Oct 6: 10:00–11:00 (fits within your morning window)
- Tue Oct 6: 15:00–16:00
- Wed Oct 7: 11:00–12:00

I've attached a short agenda draft and a quick pre-meeting questionnaire so we can tailor the demo. If none of those work, share an alternate time and we'll reschedule.

Agenda (draft):
1) 10m — goals and architecture context (HealthSpring inputs)
2) 30m — SDK + streaming demo (Python SDK, streaming token handling, chunked responses)
3) 15m — tool/function calling examples and patterns (external calls, fallbacks)
4) 5m — next steps / action items

Link to calendar invite (tentative): https://calendly.com/sergio-alvarez/rdw-tech-deepdive

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Sergio and Monica,

Thanks — the agenda looks good. Can we move the session a little later? The engineering leads on our side have a conflict at 10:00. Proposed updated times (PST):
- Tue Oct 6: 16:00–17:00 (we realize this is late but could make it work)
- Wed Oct 7: 11:30–12:30

A few specific asks so the demo can be directly applicable:
- Show an example of long-running conversation state / KV cache sizing and how the hosted runtime handles eviction and persistence (we persist some keys to our DB)
- For streaming: demonstrate resuming/partial consumption if a client drops mid-response (client fault tolerance)
- Tool calling: sample pattern for idempotent external lookups and error handling

If you prefer, we can pivot to Wed 11:30 and keep it to 60 minutes.

Thanks — Emily

Date: 2026-10-04T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming Wed Oct 7 11:30–12:30 PST — Hosted API integration deep-dive

Hi Emily,

Thanks for the alternate times — Wed Oct 7 11:30–12:30 PST works for us. We'll run 60 minutes and focus on the items you listed. Quick notes on what we'll prepare:

- SDK patterns: short samples in Python and Node showing session management, streaming client usage, and recommended batching semantics.
- Streaming fault tolerance: we'll demonstrate partial reads and resumption strategies using a small sample client that simulates mid-stream disconnects.
- KV cache guidance: sizing heuristics and eviction patterns; we'll outline compatibility with Redis and our prefix/KV cache behavior in hosted mode.
- Tool calling: patterns for idempotent external calls, retry windows, and safe fallbacks.

Agenda (final):
- 11:30 — introductions and goals (5m)
- 11:35 — architecture context & constraints (10m)
- 11:45 — live SDK + streaming demo (25m)
- 12:10 — tool/function calling patterns + Q/A (15m)
- 12:25 — next steps / action items (5m)

I've created a Google Meet link and attached a short pre-meeting questionnaire to capture any environment details (API key scope, expected peak requests/sec, sample payload sizes). Please fill it out if possible: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-healthspring-agenda

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/rdw-healthspring-demo
Calendly (in case you need to reschedule): https://calendly.com/sergio-alvarez/rdw-tech-deepdive

Attachments: pre-meeting-questions.md

See you Wed — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks — Emily
